story.title: From a single transport license in 2008 to a full-service logistics group.
story.body: Abu Sonbul was established in Jordan in 2008 by Mr. Raed Abdel Fatah Abu Sonbul. What started as a transport operation has grown into a vertically integrated logistics partner running camps, catering, equipment rental and cross-border supply chain for some of the most demanding clients in the energy and infrastructure sectors.

founder.name: Mr. Raed Abdel Fatah Abu Sonbul
points: Over 30 years of experience in logistics, transport and project management.
Strong leadership in executing large-scale projects in Jordan.
Visionary approach in expanding Abu Sonbul Logistics into new markets.
Committed to delivering excellence and building long-term partnerships.
Personally directed the ADNOC Azraq and Sarhan camp programmes — 2+ years of full-service delivery including camp construction, cross-border transport from the UAE, catering and housekeeping.
Led the ARGAS Al-Jaffr project in southern Jordan, overseeing cross-border freight from Saudi Arabia, full camp construction and daily site operations.
Built and scaled a team of over 80 professionals across six specialised departments.
Established long-term partnerships with major energy sector operators including ADNOC, ARGAS and government entities.
